name: white bean smoothie
instructions:
A smoothie with WHITE BEANS as the body. VARIANT A is the berry-flavored build:

=== VARIANT A — BERRY ===

- STRAWBERRIES
- YOGURT / GREEK YOGURT
- WHITE BEANS
- a dash of VANILLA
- VANILLA WHEY PROTEIN POWDER — REQUIRED here, not optional (see notes)

Blend.
notes:
=== BERRIES ARE OPTIMAL — THE COLOR RULE ===

STRAWBERRIES / BLUEBERRIES are optimal for white bean smoothies because they make it a PLEASANT COLOR — whereas APPLES are the pick in spinach smoothies ([[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]]) because they're COLOR NEUTRAL. The fruit slot is partly a color slot: pick the fruit that flatters the base.

=== PROTEIN POWDER IS REQUIRED HERE (UNLIKE THE SPINACH SMOOTHIE) ===

Unlike the spinach smoothie, the protein powder here is REQUIRED: it adds SWEETNESS, and the BEANS NEED MORE WORK than greens do to read as a pleasant smoothie.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[spinach-yogurt-smoothie]]: the leafy-green protein smoothie — same yogurt + vanilla protein chassis, color-neutral apple instead of berries.
- [[frozen-cucumber-smoothie]] / [[cucumber-avocado-smoothie]]: the cucumber smoothies (dessert and savory).
